title: React Component Generator
description: Generate React components or Next.js App Router route files.

name.description: Name of the component (e.g., Button, UserCard, ProductList). Uses PascalCase naming conventions for React components.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this component?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ (default depends on componentType: 'components', or 'app' for 'page'). For 'page', use inferPath instead to derive the route from name.

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for component creation

projectName.description: Target project name where component will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

componentType.description: Bucket of file to generate: 'component' (basic React component) or 'page' (App Router route file). See 'kind' for the specific file.

x-prompt.message: Which type of file would you like to generate?

kind.description: Specific file within componentType (default 'generic'). component: generic, modal, card, form. page: generic (page.tsx), layout, loading, error, not-found, template, default, global-error, route. A mismatched kind falls back to 'generic' with a warning.

x-prompt.message: Which kind would you like to generate?

inferPath.description: componentType 'page': derive the nested route from name instead of package (e.g. UserResourceFiles -> app/user/resource/files). Does not yet support [slug]/(group) syntax.

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the generated component from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
